test.text: The link is announced as "News, link."
Tabbing to the link shows focus and the label is read by the screen reader.

steps: Add an aria-label to the <a> element.
Use a concise, descriptive label such as "News".
Verify the label appears in screen‑reader output.
Ensure the label is not duplicated elsewhere.
content.explanation: The link contains only an image with no accessible text, so screen readers announce nothing and keyboard users cannot identify its purpose.
